Great, a fantastic experience
Nov 2025 • Couples
Go to this beautiful Kapi Café, it is an incredible experience 👍🏼😉!!
The staff is adorable, a little buggie pick you up at the entrance (we had taken a Grab to get there), to take you to the cafe (you have to pass through a residential area). 
It’s all about capybaras, it’s great! 
The animals are very kind, you can buy food to feed them and also pet the animals. The staff are kind and know their animals well. 
We recommend 200%!
The drinks offered are good, we had fresh coconut and coconut coffee.
